headers.subject: Re-authenticate to keep your Microsoft 365 access

body_text:
Your session has expired. Click the link below to verify your account and password within 30 minutes, otherwise access will be revoked.

Re-authenticate: http://xn--micrsoft-9ya.example/account/verify

Microsoft 365 Team
label: phishing
notes: Punycode 同形域名仿冒 Microsoft，显示名包含品牌但真实域名不匹配；认证失败并诱导输入密码。
